title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 1.33 (quiet) at 20:00 UTC on 19 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 19 日 20:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 1.33（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest hour-start estimated Kp = 1.33 (label 1P). Last-180-sample maximum is 1.67 (at 17:56 UTC); published-window maximum is 1.67 (at 14:59 UTC). Hours through 13:00 UTC have rolled out of the public window; the 14:00 UTC bin is nearly rolled out (1 sample left at 14:59). Completed bins 15:00–19:00 UTC closed at 1.00 / 1.33 / 1.67 / 1.00 / 1.33 respectively (15:00 peak 1.00 / 1Z, 60 samples; 16:00 peak 1.33 / 1P at 16:49, closed at 1.33 / 1P, 60 samples; 17:00 peak 1.67 / 2M at 17:32, closed at 1.67 / 2M, 60 samples; 18:00 peak 1.00 / 1Z, closed at 1.00 / 1Z, 60 samples; 19:00 peak 1.33 / 1P at 19:12, closed at 1.33 / 1P, 60 samples). 20:00 UTC bin is in progress (56 samples; peak 1.67 / 2M at 20:05, last 0.67 / 1M at 20:55). estimated_kp remains below 5.0.

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute (20:00 UTC; 21:00 UTC not yet in the public file). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window (~357 samples), so earlier hours fall out of the file. The in-progress 20:00 UTC hour currently ends at 0.67 / 1M and may be revised as NOAA updates.

title.en: A magnitude 5.2 earthquake occurred on the Reykjanes Ridge on 19 September 2026.

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mww 5.2, depth about 10 km. Newly listed this hour. Current day-feed maximum remains mww 5.5 (us7000tigd).
summary.zh: USGS M4.5+ 一日饋送：mww 5.2，深度約 10 公里。本輪新上架。一日饋送目前最大仍為 mww 5.5（us7000tigd）。

evidence.method: Added from the public USGS all-day M4.5+ GeoJSON feed when the event first appeared in the rolling 24-hour window.
evidence.limitations: Magnitudes and locations can be revised by USGS. The day feed only retains recent M4.5+ events.
